**Severity:** error · **Area:** Config / plugin options (`RV7xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Editor manifest missing: resume-mode and route checks cannot run. Run `rivet sync` (or `vite build`) first.
```

## How to fix

Run `rivet sync` (or `vite build`) to write .rivet/editor.json, then re-run rivet-check.

## When it is reported

rivet-check only (project-level, filename = `<root>`/.rivet/editor.json).
